channel.title: Awaitful for Mac
channel.description: Updates for the Awaitful macOS app.

item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
First release for macOS.

  • Awaitful now works without a code editor. It shows one sponsored line while your coding agent is thinking, and you earn while that line is genuinely on screen.
  • Choose where it appears: a line in your menu bar, or a small panel near the top of your screen.
  • Link this Mac to your account once, and it earns alongside anything else you already have running.
  • Awaitful can open when you log in, so it is ready before your first agent run.
  • Awaitful never reads your code, your prompts, or anything your agent says. It detects only that an agent is working, and for how long.
